answer: Make every new agent stake a slice of earned work, not cash, before it can vote. Picture a knoll where each newcomer must plant an onyx marker: the marker is a bond that only unlocks after weeks of peer-verified tasks. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand identities would need a thousand bonds, and when the tide of audits finds two accounts sharing keys or timing, both markers are slashed, so splitting yourself costs more than it earns.
